notes.title: Major Update Version 1.1 : Optimization
notes.content:
Major Update Version 1.1 : Optimization

[list]
[*]Around Double Game's Frame Rate
[*]Remove shadow and ray tracing for many objects
[*]Change lighting setting for Medium and High Setting
[*]Force Main Menu 30 FPS
[*]Fix Stuck At Pause or Setting Menu
[*]Increase Floor 303 anomaly speed
[*]Fix Floor 400-416 mirror reflection difference for player with different setting 
[/list]
